reason: I'll take the free first collab since the café is someone I've already worked with, but I'm not paying for a pass that also expects me to make promo videos for other businesses. I have a rate card, and video work is what I invoice for.

would_change_my_mind: Mitra saying in writing that the promo videos are optional or paid at my rate, and showing me real paid (not barter) Bengaluru collabs from the free one that I couldn't have got from my groups.
